name: deck-properties
body: A deck's author-declared `properties:` block: arbitrary string keys, chosen freely by the author, each mapped to a simple typed YAML scalar value (string, number, boolean or date). Deck-wide: available to every slide layout and every section template under the `deck.properties` context (template-context). Values travel as typed values — a string is escaped text, rendered as text rather than Markdown or pre-rendered safe HTML (domain.constraint.deck-properties-typed-scalars). A mapping or sequence value is a config error naming the key (domain.constraint.deck-properties-typed-scalars). Belongs to deck-config (domain.value.deck-config).
